overview: Model a minifigure-style Jedi in white robes holding a blue lightsaber. Build as 4 major sub-assemblies: legs/stance, torso+arms, head+hair, and lightsaber. Use mostly white/light pieces for the body, tan for skin, and gray+trans-blue accents for the saber.

subassemblies.name: Legs & lower robe/stance
subassemblies.description: 1 lower body block shaped like 2 legs: build a 2x2 core with 2 feet, plus 2 small front robe panels to suggest the white tunic; add 1 thin belt hint at the waistline (dark/tan accent).

subassemblies.name: Torso (robe) + 2 arms
subassemblies.description: 1 torso block (white robe) with 2 shoulders; 2 arms angled forward to a 2-hand grip pose; include 1 belt stripe across the waist (reddish-brown/dark accent) and 1 V-neck detail using contrasting plates/tiles.

subassemblies.name: Head + hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head (tan/light) with 2 eyes + 1 mouth expression suggested via small dark tiles/plates; 1 shaggy blond hair cap made from layered curved slopes/tiles (3-5 pieces) over the top and sides.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber (hilt + blade)
subassemblies.description: 1 lightsaber: 1 cylindrical gray hilt (stack of 3–4 round/short elements) with 1 small emitter tip, plus 1 long blue blade (1 bar/rod) angled up-right; connect to the hands with 1 grip segment.
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, running from hands to top-right corner
